Assam Floods Disrupt Transportation and Relief Efforts

Heavy rainfall in Assam has caused widespread flooding, affecting nearly 16,000 people and disrupting transportation. The government is mobilizing relief efforts, while trains have been halted due to bridge damage. The floods have also inundated six districts, with over 22,000 people impacted.
